entries.note: Posted at the counter, in Kenya or, for mail from abroad, at the sending post.

entries.wording: Received at Exchnage office for dispatch
entries.note: Sic. At the office of exchange of the posting country, before it sends the item abroad.

entries.wording: Received at Exchange office for delivery
entries.note: Arrived at an office of exchange abroad or in Kenya, on the way or at the destination.
Customs handed the item back to the post, which went on to deliver it: a release, which the shared rules would read as customs.
Received at a Kenyan office from the office named on the place's second line.
Followed by the reason and the measure taken, such as the item being held while the addressee is notified.
Followed by who signed and their identity document, which are not read.
